channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new fellowship - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Structurist Creative Research Fellowship (4th round)
    https://kagcag.usask.ca/engage/special-projects/structurist/fellowship.php
